"He ''is'' a little one. Blast him!|This droid and a [[Unidentified B1 battle droid 4 (Rugosa)/Legends|fellow droid]] noticing Yoda|{{TCW|Ambush}}}} A '''B1 battle droid''' was part of [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]]' [[Droid/Legends|droid]] forces stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Rugosa/Legends|Rugosa]] around [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] and participated in the [[Battle of Rugosa/Legends|Battle of Rugosa]] under command of [[OOM command battle droid/Legends|battle droid commander]] [[224/Legends|224]] during a deal between [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]] and [[King/Legends|King]] [[Katuunko/Legends|Katuunko]] of the [[Toydarian/Legends|Toydarians]]. When [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] intervened and began destroying Ventress' droids, [[OOM command battle droid/Legends|battle droid commander]] 224 and several of their droids were sent out to defeat them, with the winner of the ensuing battle gaining Katuunko's trust. During the battle, the battle droid was destroyed by Yoda, along with its companions. ==Biography== [[File:B1s-see-Yoda.png|thumb|left|250px|The B1 and his fellows on Rugosa]] The [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] was a [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droid]] manufactured by [[Baktoid Combat Automata/Legends|Baktoid Combat Automata]] and [[Baktoid Armor Workshop/Legends|Baktoid Armor Workshop]] to serve in the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a conflict between the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. During the war, the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] was deployed amongst a [[T81 Division|battalion]] of battle droids to the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Rugosa/Legends|Rugosa]], under the command of the [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] and the [[OOM command battle droid/Legends|battle droid commander]] [[224/Legends|224]]. The Separatists had learned that [[King/Legends|King]] [[Katuunko/Legends|Katuunko]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Toydarian/Legends|Toydaria]] and [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] were [[Battle of Rugosa/Legends|meeting]] in secret on the moon in order to discuss a Republic supply post being created on Toydaria in exchange for protection of the [[Toydarian/Legends|Toydarian]] people. Ventress had managed to reach Katuunko first, and offered Separatist protection instead, but after she and the king learned that Yoda had successfully landed on the planet, an agreement was made. If Yoda could defeat her droid forces and reach Katuunko, he would have the allegiance of the Toydarians but if he failed they would side with the Separatists instead. After arriving on the moon in a [[C-9979 landing craft/Legends|C-9979 landing craft]], commander 224 led a section of the droid forces including this one to find and defeat Yoda, including three [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|Armored Assault Tanks]], one of which this droid walked alongside. Entering the coral forests of Rugosa, they soon sighted the Jedi Grand Master, who was accompanied by three [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]], nicknamed [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Thire/Legends|Thire]], [[Jek/Legends|Jek]] and [[Rys/Legends|Rys]], and ordered his troops to open fire. The Separatist forces were out of range, however, and 224 soon had to give the order to stop as the tanks could not fit through the surrounding foliage. As the vehicles could not continue, 224 remained behind while sending out ground troops to find the Republic forces. While patrolling with several other droids, another droid noticed a small green creature, and pointed it out to their companions. This droid irritably told them that this was Master Yoda and noted that he certainly was, as Ventress had stated earlier, a little one. The droid then ordered its companions to blast the Jedi, and it and its fellow droids all did so. However, after initially splitting up into [[Squad/Legends|squads]], they were all eventually cut down by Yoda. Yoda and his companions destroyed two patrols of B1 battle droids and a group of [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2 super battle droids]], but were eventually driven back by [[Droideka/Legends|droidekas]]. Yoda was ultimately successful in defeating the remaining droid forces and reaching the rendezvous point, earning the allegiance of the Toydarians. ==Characteristics== Like all B1 battle droids within the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]], the driver stood at 1.93 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall and had [[Gender/Legends|masculine]] programming''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Character Encyclopedia]]''. Created for the purpose of both combat and driving, it sported [[Color/Legends|tan-colored]] plating. ==Behind the scenes== The droid's first and only appearance was in the first episode of the animated television series ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]''{{'}} [[Clone Wars: Season One|first season]], ''[[Ambush]]'', that aired in [[2008]]. Like all battle droids in the series, it was voiced by [[Matthew Wood]]. ==Appearances== *{{TCW|Ambush}} {{1st}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} [[Category:B1-series battle droids]] [[Category:Droids of the Confederacy of Independent Systems]] [[Category:Droids with masculine programming]] [[Category:Droids with unspecified pronouns]]
